headline: German automakers face the threat of labor union conflicts
summary: Volkswagen has said deep cost reductions are necessary to remain competitive. German automakers face the threat of union conflicts, according to the report.
why: Volkswagen is one of the world's largest carmakers, and labor costs and union negotiations in Germany directly affect its margins and competitiveness.

impacts.name: Volkswagen
impacts.why: The company says deep cost cuts are needed, and union conflict is a risk to that restructuring effort.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Automotrices alemanas se enfrentan a amenaza de conflictos sindicales
